company.shortDescription: Herbie is an enterprise AI platform that provides multilingual conversational AI agents, chatbot systems, and workflow automation tools.
company.description: Herbie is an enterprise conversational AI and automation platform that provides multilingual virtual assistants, AI agents, and voice-enabled chatbot systems for customer service and business operations. The platform supports deployment across web, mobile, messaging applications, and social channels, with integrations for enterprise systems such as CRM, ERP, HR, and document management platforms. Herbie.AI offers features including conversational AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), workflow automation, live agent handoff, API integrations, and multilingual support across more than 130 languages. The company serves industries including banking, insurance, healthcare, retail, education, manufacturing, and government, and provides deployment options through cloud, on-premises, and hybrid infrastructure models.
